lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal crystal Ba10Zr2O12 (reduced formula Ba5ZrO6) adopts space group I-4 (No. 38), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zr centers as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ba centers show 10-fold coordination, with some O environments exhibiting a 12-neighbor close-packed-like arrangement. Corner-sharing between ZrO6 octahedra and Ba-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, along with edge- and face-sharing between Ba polyhedra, are observed in the validated polyhedron-sharing analysis. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
